# GitHub Actions secret scanning and push protection configuration.
# These settings are managed via the GitHub repository's Security settings UI.
# This file documents the recommended configuration for new contributors.

# Recommended GitHub repository security settings:
#   Settings > Security > Secret scanning: ENABLED
#   Settings > Security > Secret scanning > Push protection: ENABLED
#   Settings > Security > Dependabot alerts: ENABLED
#   Settings > Security > Dependabot security updates: ENABLED
#   Settings > Code security > Private vulnerability reporting: ENABLED

# No additional file-based configuration required for GitHub secret scanning.
# All configuration is handled through the repository settings UI.
